entries.018dcddbb5ddb6ab: Production of broadcast programs, films, anime and events
entries.02d197858a87e8a5: This business engages in television and radio broadcasting, production of programs, films, anime and events, sales of video and music software, advertising, mail-order sales and other activities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥349,876 million, the largest of the reportable segments (previous year: ¥403,479 million). The company explains that, due to an incident at its subsidiary Fuji Television Network, Inc., terrestrial TV advertising revenue fell sharply, mainly in the first half. On the other hand, it states that its content business remained solid, including subscription income from the streaming service “FOD” and hit films.
entries.17a8051e592ec218: Users of hotels and other facilities
entries.281ff7dd39c652b6: This is a business not included in reportable segments and includes temporary staffing, movable asset leasing, and software development. Nippon Broadcasting Project Co., Ltd. handles movable asset leasing and merchandise sales, and Fuji Nextera Lab Co., Ltd. handles software development. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,129 million.
entries.32783e1648484886: Advertising, mail-order sales and publishing of magazines and books
entries.3abd3fb2546458a5: Publishing of magazines and books is handled by Fusosha Publishing Inc. The publication of newspapers is carried out by Sangyo Keizai Shimbun Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate.
entries.3ba99d1e97a2e525: Building Leasing and Real Estate Transactions
entries.3d807462c436067b: This segment engages in TV broadcasting, including terrestrial broadcasting. The main companies are Fuji Television Network, Inc., Sendai Hoso Co., Ltd. and BS Fuji Co., Ltd., and Kansai Television Co., Ltd., Nihon Eiga Hoso Co., Ltd. and WOWOW Inc. are equity-method affiliates. Fuji Television Network, Inc. recorded revenue of ¥173,701 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, down 18.9% year on year.
entries.49f42208a7d96a80: This segment leases office buildings and rental residences, trades in real estate, and sells condominiums, and is handled by Sankei Building Co., Ltd. Building management is carried out by Sankei Building Techno Co., Ltd., Sankei Building Management Co., Ltd., and Sankei Building Well-Care Co., Ltd. Revenue of Sankei Building Co., Ltd. for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥112,851 million.
entries.55727c703abe863e: This segment handles advertising placement, marketing and promotion, and is undertaken by Quoras Co., Ltd.
entries.5d4a757e5dd7256e: This business rents out buildings, trades in real estate, and operates hotels and resorts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥192,859 million, up from ¥140,431 million in the previous fiscal year. The company explains that the increase in revenue was due to the sale of owned and developed properties, the sale of large-scale condominiums, a full year's contribution from Kobe Suma Sea World, and hotel occupancy that captured demand from inbound visitors to Japan.
entries.9bc90fde3aeb1b69: This segment produces broadcast programs and other content and is handled by Kyodo Television Co., Ltd., Fujiar Co., Ltd. and Fuji Creative Corporation.
entries.a16ed94014f0467a: This segment operates hotels and resort facilities and is handled by Grand Vista Hotel & Resort Co., Ltd. The company explains that hotels it operates, including the InterGate Hotel series, and Kobe Suma Sea World contributed to the revenue increase for the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.a36be2d1507fc7e0: This segment conducts radio broadcasting and is handled by Nippon Broadcasting System, Inc. The company explains that, for the fiscal year ended March 2026, time sales were strong and the broadcasting business saw revenue increase, while overall revenue decreased due to the reactionary decline from large events in the previous year.
entries.af6a1461e0a1edbc: Pony Canyon, Inc. handles the sale of video and music software, and Fuji Pacific Music Inc. handles music publishing. The company explains that, for the fiscal year ended March 2026, Pony Canyon, Inc. advanced structural reforms related to anime.
entries.b90106bd176b9b14: Events and Interior Work, Building Management
entries.c167f3dc4b2f58dd: This segment covers mail-order sales through catalogs and television and is handled by dinos Co., Ltd.
entries.ed228901217e5dd1: Video and Music Software Sales and Music Publishing and Other
entries.f736fdc1f752ea7a: An authorized broadcasting holding company engaged in a media business of television and radio broadcasting, production of programs and video content, and advertising, as well as building leasing and hotel operation.
entries.f96ed94ec7d17812: Sales of video and music software and music publishing
